facts.text: Le Sereno is a St. Barths hotel located on the waters of the Grand Cul De Sac.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Le Sereno, an iconic St. Barths hotel located on the ultra-private crystal-clear waters of the Grand Cul De Sac.

facts.text: Le Sereno is an intimate beachfront resort known for its contemporary design and understated luxury service.
facts.excerpt: Our intimate beachfront resort has long beckoned travelers for its contemporary design and understated luxury service.

facts.text: Accommodation categories include the Grand Suite Plage, the Grand Suite Plage Sud, the Bungalow Piscine and the Sereno Villas.

facts.text: The hotel has its own spa, Le Sereno Spa.
The Le Sereno Villas combine the privacy of a private villa with the amenities and service of a five-star hotel.
facts.excerpt: the privacy and the expansiveness of a private villa combined with the amenities and service of a five-star hotel

facts.text: Each Le Sereno Villa offers more than 7,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space in half an acre of private landscaped garden.
facts.excerpt: Each of the three Villas offer more than 7,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space in a half an acre of private landscaped garden.

facts.text: Each villa has three to four bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and expansive terraces.
facts.excerpt: each private villa features three to four bedrooms, large living areas, fully equipped kitchen, expansive terraces

facts.text: Each villa has a heated private pool overlooking the Grand Cul-de-Sac.
facts.excerpt: heated private pools overlooking the magnificent views over the Grand Cul-de Sac

facts.text: The villas have a wood-paneled library with a media room and surround-sound large-screen home theater.
facts.excerpt: Wood-paneled Library with en-suite bathroom. Media room, surround-sound large screen home theater.

facts.text: The villa kitchens have aluminum Schiffini cabinets by Vico Magistretti.
facts.excerpt: Fully equipped designer kitchen with aluminum Schiffini cabinets by Vico Magistretti

facts.text: The villas have a large covered terrace with a panoramic ocean view, a dining table and a lounge.
facts.excerpt: Large Covered terrace with panoramic ocean view with dining table (seats 8 comfortably) and lounge.

facts.text: The Le Sereno Villas are considered by many to be the finest luxury accommodations in St. Barths.
facts.excerpt: The Le Sereno Villas are considered by many to be the finest luxury accommodations in St. Barths.

facts.text: A seasonal package includes non-motorized water activities.
